subject: Proposal: 3-week trial + evaluation checklist for Harmonia AI
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@harmonia.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap & proposed 3-week trial for Harmonia AI

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap plus a compact trial proposal so your team can review with Sam and the ML ops folks. TL;DR: three-week sandbox trial, Redwood-managed evaluation harness, clear success criteria, and a single rollback-safe integration path.

Demo highlights (from our call)
- Inference latency for your 512-token prompts during the demo averaged ~120ms p95 on our dedicated V100 pool.
- We showed prefix caching and a simple reranking flow for your NLU intent scorer.
- Security: VPC-only private control plane / customer-managed keys available for the trial.

Proposed 3-week trial (outline)
1) Week 0 (prep, 2-3 business days)
   - We provide sandbox credentials and a small test dataset (anonymized).
   - Deliverable: trial environment access + test harness checklist.
2) Week 1 (integration & smoke tests)
   - Integrate Redwood API with your staging pipeline; run canonical prompts.
   - Deliverable: integration notes + latency/cost baseline dashboard.
3) Week 2 (evaluation & metric run)
   - Run evaluation suite (see attached eval plan). We’ll run A/B against your current model.
   - Deliverable: evaluation report and regression checks.
4) Week 3 (tuning & wrap)
   - Apply config suggestions (batching/quantization), verify SLAs, and produce go/no-go recommendation.

Success criteria (we recommend you pick 2–3):
- Latency: reduce p95 inference time by >= 15% vs current endpoint, OR p95 <= 140ms for target prompts.
- Cost: token-level cost reduced by >= 20% on our suggested config.
- Quality: no top-line degradation in intent-classification F1 (<= 1.5% delta).
- Reliability: < 0.5% error rate during test windows.

Ownership & contacts
- Redwood engineering (integration lead): Monica Patel — will coordinate sandbox and test harness.
- Redwood solutions (commercial): Sean Gallagher — trial logistics and commercial questions.
- Harmonia point-of-contact: Emma Park (technical) and Sam Lee (CTO).

Next steps (what I need from you)
- Confirm priorities (which 2–3 success criteria matter most).
- Approve proposed kickoff window: Nov 3–6 (prep week starting Nov 3).
- Provide a staging dataset pointer or share a short sample (<= 500 examples).

Attachments included: redwood-trial-eval-plan-v1.pdf (detailed checklist + sample dashboards), access-instructions.txt (sandbox SSH/API creds flow).

If that looks good I’ll send the HubSpot trial record and a short DocuSign for the trial terms (standard 30-day trial agreement).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0210

From: Emma Park <emma@harmonia.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@harmonia.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed 3-week trial for Harmonia AI

Sean —

Thanks for the clear outline. A few quick clarifying questions before we lock dates:
1) Data retention: during the trial, will Redwood hold the request/response logs longer than 30 days by default? We need to ensure we can meet our retention policy.
2) Model parity: can we pin the trial to the same model family we discussed (open-variant-xl-4) and get a note on any quantized variant effects we should expect?
3) Evaluation metrics: for the quality check, we will want both intent F1 and a secondary acceptability/quality metric (human-rated mean score). Can Redwood ingest our human ratings CSV during the run?

Sam is cc’d — he wants to confirm our security team will need the SOC2 artifact and an IP allowlist for the sandbox IPs.

If the answers are straightforward we can start the prep Nov 3. Otherwise we may need a day to loop in legal/security.

Best,
Emma
VP Product, Harmonia AI
emma@harmonia.ai

Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed 3-week trial for Harmonia AI

Emma — thanks, great questions. Short answers below; details attached.

1) Data retention
   - Redwood will default to 30-day logs for trial sandboxes. We can set a shorter TTL (7 days) on request; nothing is persisted beyond your policy window unless you ask us to. (See section 2.1 of the attached PDF.)
2) Model parity
   - We’ll pin to open-variant-xl-4 for the trial. We recommend the fp16 path for fidelity; quantized INT8 will be an optional config in Week 3 for cost testing. Expect a small quality delta (0.5–1.2% on sensitive intents) when moving to INT8 — we’ll surface regression warnings in the eval report.
3) Human ratings ingestion
   - Yes — you can upload a CSV (id, prompt_id, rater_score) to the sandbox folder. Our evaluation harness will join and compute mean opinion scores alongside automated metrics.

Security artifacts
- Monica will send SOC 2 summary (redacted) and a short allowlist of trial IPs by EOD today. For the sandbox we’ll provide a fixed range for your security team to allow.

Kickoff and logistics
- Proposed prep window still Nov 3–6. If that works, I’ll create the HubSpot trial record and send the DocuSign for standard trial terms (two small fields to confirm).
- Sandbox credentials: attached as trial-sandbox-credentials.csv (credentials are time-limited).

Next steps (action items)
- Emma: confirm success criteria priorities (latency / cost / quality + human rating).
- Sam: confirm security OK with 30-day default or if you require 7-day TTL.
- Monica: please attach SOC2 summary + allowlist (EOD).

Forwarding attachments: redwood-trial-eval-plan-v1.pdf; trial-sandbox-credentials.csv; access-instructions.txt

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
